result.final_answer: Cargo.toml and README.md show a workspace with 28 members under crates. Manifests show repeated role prefixes: core, fx, session, turns, compute, pax, project, graph, wasm, decision, corpus, remote, native, inference; package descriptions only say each crate owns one responsibility, while README establishes chip-core-0 as the base. Dependencies form a layered graph: most members depend on chip-core-0; early crates add fx/session/turns; mid/later crates depend on compute, pax, project, graph, wasm, decision, corpus, remote, native, or inference variants. Manifests also use shared external deps and tempfile as dev. They do not show APIs or runtime behavior.
